title: Surf Air Mobility Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Meeting Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA Guidance
summary: Second Quarter Revenue of $29.5 Million, Driven By Over 100% Year-Over-Year Increase In Surf On Demand Private Charter Revenue, At the High End of the Guidance Range of $27 Million to $30 Million Second Quarter Adjusted EBITDA Loss of $10.5 Million, Within the Guidance Range of $10.5 Million to $8.5 Million Signed First SurfOS Enterprise Software Contract with Wheels Up and Expanded Partnership with Palantir Technologies Reduced Existing Convertible Note Principal by 64% and Lowered Monthly Cash Amortization Payments by Up to 50% Company Reaffirms Full Year 2026 Guidance and Issues Third Quarter 2026 Guidance Surf Air Mobility Inc. (NYSE: SRFM) ("Surf Air Mobility" or the "Company"), a leading air mobility platform, today reported financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, and provided a progress update for the Company's airline operations, Surf On Demand private charter, and SurfOS software businesses.
